reason: I have only ever hired builders through word of mouth, and I would rather pay the crew directly than give a middleman a cut. A platform I have never heard of, with no reviews I can read, asking me to hand it my money and the contract is a hard sell.
objection: Who actually gets paid for the work, and what does the platform take on top of the builder's price? If I cannot see real reviews of the builders and of the platform itself, I will not sign anything.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or neighbour who has used it for a flat renovation and vouches for it, plus a clear breakdown showing the platform fee is small and the builder's price is not inflated.
